sources.title: Zaahen Build Guide: Season 16 Challenger Zaahen guide
Zaahen Build Guides, Runes, Items, and Abilities - Patch 26.19

passive.name: Cultivation of War
passive.text: Zaahen's attacks and abilities against enemy champions grant him stacks of Determination, gaining bonus Attack Damage per stack. When filled with Determination, Zaahen gains increased Attack Damage and can revive.

spells.name: The Darkin Glaive
spells.text: Zaahen slashes twice on his next attack, dealing bonus damage and healing himself. Zaahen can recast this ability to have his next attack deal bonus damage and knock up his target.

spells.name: Dreaded Return
spells.text: Zaahen stabs in a direction, damaging enemies hit, then pulls them toward him.

spells.name: Aureate Rush
spells.text: Zaahen dashes to a location and slices around himself.

spells.name: Grim Deliverance
spells.text: Zaahen rises then stabs downward, damaging enemies and healing for a portion of the damage dealt.

damage.value: Zaahen deals physical damage with Q and builds sustained damage through Determination stacks.

archetype.value: Zaahen is a bruiser who fights with attacks, self-healing, and a dash.

axis.value: Zaahen favors long trades because his attacks and abilities build Determination stacks.

spikes.why: Zaahen gets stronger because he can jump around and spam abilities in fights.
Zaahen benefits from its ability haste.
Zaahen gains bonus attack damage and can revive when Determination is full.

bait.why: When Zaahen spends W, he cannot use its pull again until the cooldown ends.
When Zaahen spends E, he cannot use its dash again until the cooldown ends.

mistakes.value: Zaahen players give up valuable ability haste by choosing Alacrity for only one or two extra basic attacks.
Zaahen gets less healing from R when its stab deals less damage.
